plaatsen.tekst: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous
The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed
Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.
For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue
Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe
